executionLayers.crypto: Actual Node v26.12.1 WebCrypto Ed25519 import/sign/verify; existing repository PUBLIC RFC8032 vector only. No newly generated keys.

guard.intentionalGuardAssertion: Independent test invokes generateKey only to assert guard throws; no key generation succeeds.

executionLayers.races: Controlled Promise barriers around resolveKey/importKey/verify. WebCrypto receives original arguments before suspension; verification result is never replaced with a mock true.
executionLayers.caller: Actual serviceAccessEvaluator with synthetic server-supplied authority snapshot and fixture terms. No live identity, issuer, Provider, DB or Broker execution.
executionLayers.testIndependence: Separate probe fixture/assertions; old-source module copied from exact base into evidence directory. Candidate source never reverted or changed.
executionLayers.oldCounts: Author old 10 failing leaf cases plus 2 aggregate parents is preserved as author evidence. Reviewer old comparison separately has 9 leaf failures; counts not merged.

findingsClosed.evidence: Later-signed scope, owner and issuer/key changes during resolver/import no longer substitute fields after initial checks; verifier call binds resolver IDs and signature bytes to detached entry values.
Caller mutations during actual WebCrypto verification and after return cannot change returned owner/parent/scope/signature. Returned object and scope are detached; return remains mutable.

Changes to passed parent epoch, contract status, allowedScopes, ownerAuthenticated and deviceProofVerified at resolver/import/verify boundaries all deny; old source accepts these independent counterexamples.

Actual unchanged serviceAccessEvaluator accepts valid candidate snapshot and denies parent/scope changes during resolveKey while retaining previously authorized read/export. Product callsite checks non-null, not object identity.

compatibility.unchanged: Exported types, constants, domain, ordered fields and signing-bytes function verified byte-identical to base. Independent signing bytes agree. Existing type/shape/signature/TTL/allowed-scope predicates retained; fact predicate extracted and reused at end. No price/API/store/DB/Broker edit.
compatibility.intentionalIdentityChange: Returned identity changes from caller alias to detached normal mutable ServiceAttachment with independent scope. Replacing the valid assertion equal by deepEqual matches that explicit contract; new alias assertions strengthen checked content/identity, and old valid/revoked/expired/tampering cases remain.
compatibility.nowContract: Same supplied now/default call-entry Date.now and TTL comparisons preserved. No dispatch-time clock refresh or lease policy expansion claimed.
compatibility.factsBoundary: Rechecks the same supplied object values at completion. It does not read fresh DB revocation state or guarantee a continuously unchanged/monotonic authority snapshot. Parent DB/Broker atomic revision/epoch checks remain required.

limitations: Full-project type/full verify, metadata/design synchronization, final-head/main integration and CI remain central work.
No real auth/provider/issuer enrollment, outbox, production D1 or complete entitlement issue-renew-revoke lifecycle accepted.
No fullESIM/whole-unit acceptance, key generation, credential creation, device changes, extra inference, paid API, contract or publication.
Returned object is mutable and not a reusable authorization; setup/Broker must obtain current facts and enforce existing atomic checks.
Specified main blob comparison is not new remote CI confirmation.
Test counts overlap and do not imply task completion percentage.
